html:
The Kalkadoon, properly Kalkatungu, are an Aboriginal people of the Mount Isa region in northwest Queensland, in the rocky Selwyn Ranges and the valleys around them.

They are remembered for their long resistance to settlers. Cattle stations came into their country from the 1860s, and the Kalkadoon fought back for some twenty years. In 1884 police and settlers attacked them at a hill now called Battle Mountain, killing many. The Battle of Battle Mountain broke their armed resistance.

Their neighbours on the map include the Mayi-Thakurti to the south, the Waanyi to the north, the Pitta Pitta to the southeast and the Yalarrnga. In 1923 rich ore was found at Mount Isa on their land, and it grew into one of the world's great mines. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Kalkadoon, properly Kalkatungu, are an Aboriginal people of the Mount Isa region in northwest Queensland, in the rocky Selwyn Ranges and the valleys around them.
